title: Image cache growth gets a ceiling
summary:
Image generation got two practical guardrails: a bounded memory cache and quieter logs.

The generated-image cache now holds up to 1,000 entries instead of 500,000, evicting the oldest entry at the limit. That bounds memory use that could degrade image generation.

The image service no longer writes progress-bar updates to non-TTY logs, reducing log growth and the risk of running out of disk space.

Progress bars now use a default color when an ID is missing.
